The stuff you love, but different... and on a loop (again... again)! This is Mashed Infinite, a continuous livestream of all your favourite Mashed cartoons. 

We collaborate with the best creators out there to bring you brand new cartoons that will make you laugh, cry, and laugh some more. If you're looking for Sonic cartoons, Super Mario cartoons, or honestly just a whole bunch of cartoons that parody your favourite video games, then you've come to the right place.
